pattern_explanation: Some Ukrainian words share a root with English words but have drifted to different meanings over time. Learners who translate by sound alone will choose the wrong English word, so the meaning must be checked against the dictionary entry.
false_friend_warning: The Ukrainian word that sounds like 'actual' means 'relevant' or 'current', not 'real'. Ukrainian speakers who trust the similar sound will write 'actual' when they mean 'relevant', so check the meaning before using the English word.
